# The engine's budgets-exact-v1 keyed route set (U-203, P28): budget writes,
# `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json. cl-api sends them (KeySet::BudgetsV1). Append-only for this capability name.
POST /api/v1/budgets
POST /api/v1/budgets/{id}/adjust-by-percent
POST /api/v1/budgets/{id}/copy-from/{sourceId}
POST /api/v1/budgets/{id}/fill-from-actuals
PUT /api/v1/budgets/{id}
PUT /api/v1/budgets/{id}/lines
